admission.justification: Weighed MathJax 3 SVG and memory-repo Pages ownership against KaTeX and code-repo Pages hosting, constraining all future explainer stages, VitePress upgrades and dual-repo CI workflows.

alternatives.option: Render LaTeX at build time via VitePress native markdown.math (markdown-it-mathjax3 producing static inline SVG) and host GitHub Pages deployment on Foxfire1st/ar-rh-proof-skeleton/.github/workflows/pages.yml while keeping a synthetic site-build-check job in rh-proof-skeleton/.github/workflows/quality.yml.
alternatives.reason: Guarantees 100% static script-off SVG math without font-bundle fragility and lets explainer/memory pushes publish automatically while code PRs stay verified without failing on Pages deployment.

alternatives.option: Render LaTeX with KaTeX client/font assets and keep GitHub Pages deployment inside Foxfire1st/rh-proof-skeleton/.github/workflows/pages.yml.
alternatives.reason: KaTeX requires webfont asset bundling and diverged from VitePress native MathJax 3 SVG support, and hosting Pages on the code repo coupled public explainer publishes to code pushes and failed on bootstrap pushes.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A future approved requirement switches the static site generator away from VitePress or moves public explainer docs back into the code repository.

consequences: system/design-guidelines.md specifies build-time MathJax 3 SVG instead of KaTeX, and site/package.json plus site/package-lock.json pin markdown-it-mathjax3 alongside vitepress.

rh-proof-skeleton removes .github/workflows/pages.yml and runs synthetic site-build-check in quality.yml, while Foxfire1st/ar-rh-proof-skeleton/.github/workflows/pages.yml owns live GitHub Pages deployment.
context: Stage 00 vertical-slice publication required choosing a build-time math renderer compatible with script-off readability and deciding which public repository owns GitHub Pages deployment when explainer essays and Concept Cards live in ar-rh-proof-skeleton.
decider: Developer (rulings RH-D03, RH-D04 and RH-D07 approving RH-R05@v1)
